title: M43 Lab Result collapse golden vector
description: Language-neutral parity cases for collapseLabResults (docs/designs/lab-results.md, Result identity and the collapse). Each case gives stored Lab Results and expects the ids the collapse keeps, in output order. Archived rows are dropped; a row whose lab does not decode (null, or an invalid collected) is its own group; the rest group by labTestKey and the lab.collected string; each group keeps final over interim or an unknown status, then the later updatedAt in whole epoch seconds (floored), then the greater id by code-unit order; kept rows are newest first by atTime, the greater id first on a tie. A reading's lab is the stored JSON object, decoded by decodeLab.

instant.description: An ISO 8601 UTC instant with a Z suffix.

metricId.description: Informational: the Lab Metric row the reading belongs to. Runners ignore it, because identity never uses the Metric row.

lab.description: The stored valueJson.lab object, or null for a reading without one.

note.description: Why the case exists and which rule it pins. Runners ignore it.
